title: release r21: V2 clause migration (634) + inversion batch 4 (1800 hazards total)
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- V2 legacy master screened per the takeover docs: 54/162 law versions mapped to V4, 634 clauses passed verbatim verification against archived fulltext and migrated with verified reviews. V2 hazards deliberately NOT bulk-migrated (quality gate history) — they are covered by the clause-inversion pipeline instead.
- Inversion batch 4: 770 hazards generated from all unlinked verified clauses (应当 inversion fix, 42 legacy titles repaired).
- Real-time gate: eligibleHazards 1030 -> 1800, eligibleLinks 1208 -> 1978, strictBlockers=0.
- r21 live: 1800 hazards / 174 laws / clauses per projection / 1978 links.
